statement.zh: 楔形文字 Meluhha 地名多数学者与印度河区对应；海湾与两河语境有哈拉帕风格器物——路线级细节须专文。
statement.en: Cuneiform Meluhha is widely linked to the Indus region; Harappan-style objects appear in Gulf/Mesopotamian contexts — route-level detail needs dedicated entries.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
